user_query: I want to cancel my marriage. It has only been 6 months.
variations: Marriage not consummated, want to split
I was forced into marriage, can I void it?
part_a_general_info: An annulment (Writ of Nullity) declares a marriage void or voidable. Unlike divorce, you do not need to wait for 3 years. Common grounds include: non-consummation due to incapacity or refusal, marriage not validly registered, one party was already married (bigamy), or consent was obtained by duress or fraud. For voidable marriages (e.g., non-consummation), proceedings generally must start within 3 years of the marriage.
triage_questions: Q1: How long have you been married?
Q2: Has the marriage been consummated?
Q3: Why do you want to annul (e.g., refusal of sex, fraud, duress)?
Q4: Is this a Civil or Muslim marriage?
branching_logic: If Q2 = Yes (consummated) → Annulment on non-consummation ground is impossible. Pivot to Divorce (FAM-01).
If Q1 > 3 years → Annulment may be time-barred for voidable marriages. Pivot to Divorce.
routing: Route A (Non-consummation/Duress): Refer to private lawyer or PBSG Family Law Clinic. Annulment is a technical legal process.
Route B (Muslim marriage): Refer to Syariah Court.
guardrail: Must NOT advise on the likelihood of proving 'refusal to consummate' or the strength of duress claims.
